title: Error messages

<!-- Generated by website/scripts/generate_reference.py. Do not edit. -->

Generated from `translations/en.json`. Edit the source, then run `npm run docs:generate` in `website/`.

Match the displayed message to the troubleshooting guide. Some messages are retained for compatibility.

## Config errors

| Key | Message |
| --- | --- |
| `invalid_address` | Please enter a valid IP address. |
| `required` | This field is required. |
| `keygen_failed` | Failed to generate an SSH key pair. Check that the cryptography library is installed. |
| `ssh_unavailable` | The paramiko library is not installed. SSH bootstrap is unavailable. |
| `ssh_token_empty` | SSH connection succeeded but the token file was empty or not found. Verify the host is running rpm-energy ≥11.2. |
| `ssh_failed` | Could not connect via SSH. Check the Host IP address and the RPM user password. |
| `ssh_password_auth_failed` | SSH password authentication failed. Verify the RPM user password. |
| `ssh_connect_failed` | Could not establish an SSH connection to the Savant host. |
| `ssh_key_install_failed` | SSH connected, but Savant Energy could not install or verify its refresh key on the host. Check the logs for the failed stage. |
| `ssh_key_verify_failed` | SSH connected and installed the refresh key, but the host rejected a new connection using that key. Check SSH ownership, permissions, and host policy. |
| `ssh_token_mismatch` | The token changed while Savant Energy was verifying its SSH refresh key. Try the setup again. |
| `setup_unexpected` | Setup failed unexpectedly. Check the logs for the sanitized failure trace and try again. |
| `org_auth_failed` | InfluxDB rejected the token or organization. Verify the token, organization ID, and Host IP, then try again. |
| `influx_auth_failed` | InfluxDB returned 401 and rejected the token for the data query. Verify that this is the read token from the same host. |
| `influx_permission_denied` | InfluxDB returned 403. The token is recognized but does not have permission to read the selected bucket. |
| `influx_org_invalid` | InfluxDB rejected the organization ID. Verify the org ID from .influxtoken or .influxsetup. |
| `influx_bucket_invalid` | InfluxDB could not read the selected bucket. Verify the bucket name from .influxtoken. |
| `influx_unreachable` | The InfluxDB host did not respond to the validation query. Verify the Host IP and port 8086. |
| `influx_query_failed` | InfluxDB rejected the validation query. Check the sanitized integration logs for the HTTP status and response detail. |
| `org_enumeration_denied` | InfluxDB would not allow organization discovery with this token. Enter the organization ID to validate direct data access. |
| `org_discovery_failed` | Could not discover a valid Influx organization from host metadata, buckets, or the org list. Check the host IP and credentials, then try again. |
| `org_discovery_no_orgs` | Influx returned no organizations visible to this token. |
| `org_discovery_no_data` | Influx organizations were found, but none matched the expected Savant energy data shape. |
| `org_selection_required` | Multiple plausible organizations were found. Choose the correct one to continue. |
| `sem_companion_failed` | Could not reach the Savant SEM companion status API on the configured PBC IP address. |
| `circuit_discovery_failed` | Could not discover Savant circuit data from InfluxDB. |
| `circuit_inventory_incomplete` | Circuit discovery was incomplete, so the existing circuit map was preserved. |
| `invalid_value` | Enter a valid number. |
| `out_of_range` | Enter a value within the allowed range. |
| `circuit_relay_mapping_failed` | One or more relay circuits could not be mapped to Savant relay UIDs. Verify the PBC IP and run Reconfigure again. |
